name: app-financeiro-v2
description: App de controle financeiro com IA

scripts.start-local: node scripts/prepare-local.js && npm run ui:build && npx vercel dev --listen 3001
scripts.ui:build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/copy-frontend-build.js
scripts.vercel-build: npm run ui:install && node scripts/generate-prisma.js && npm run ui:build
scripts.postinstall: npm run ui:install && node scripts/generate-prisma.js || true
